events.event: Independent native/passive router before optional work
events.funding: B/R/T/I/N for every actual inspected binding, field, predicate, traversal or query
events.payer: Existing request; no implicit setup credit
events.failure_continuation: Unsupported route goes to original dynamic path only through safe entry; added charge refusal stops

events.funding: C/W for receipt and fields; B/R/T/I/N for every proof-only inspection or query
events.payer: Original production retains its O; only genuinely existing facts may be reused
events.failure_continuation: Incomplete or failed producer issues no usable receipt; spent setup remains

events.event: Actual aliases, cached list and relevant dispatch/work state
events.funding: B/R/T/I/W for every validation, maintained occurrence and invalidation
events.payer: Same request; no cross-request or implicit cross-occurrence amortization
events.failure_continuation: Invalidation before omission selects original path; after omission needs separate exact restoration design

events.event: Current invocation admission after original wrapper effects
events.funding: B/R/T/I/C/W for current receipt, identities, lengths, coverage, full live cap and retained state
events.payer: No reassignment of original geometry point or work.lookup charges
events.failure_continuation: False keeps optional costs and executes original dynamic direct; refusal terminates

events.funding: R for row/component reads; T for needed shape/type/finite/domain predicates; 3 N abs, 2 N add, 2 N nextafter; C/W for actual retained record fields
events.payer: All unestablished predicates paid; no future Fraction decode
events.failure_continuation: Unsuitable native seed declines without original future-row exception; foreign seed must not be touched early

events.funding: O for every retained point/conversion/error/guard; one T for each new strict comparison and one T for each pending identity recognition; every extra bookkeeping occurrence paid
events.payer: Only completed justified original folds omitted; partial folds count actual events
events.failure_continuation: No newly exposed foreign operations; genuine native refusal recorded at actual charge

events.event: Seed occurrence or separately justified earlier redundancy
events.funding: W for every actual pending/receipt/reference state change; B/R/T/N for any separately selected early test
events.payer: No free optional early stopping test
events.failure_continuation: Release/finalization must be passive under exact authority; original suffix remains

events.event: Rejected or repeated admission, retry, cache eviction, wrapper direct rescan
events.funding: Every reached optional unit again; complete additional original work as O; explicit F for reconstruction/replay
events.payer: No refunds, no unique-object incidence shortcut
events.failure_continuation: Preserve first exceptions, actual counts and failures; warm hit has no cold omission opportunity

non_overlap: Every concrete event once; repeated optional events remain in their A/S/I category; F contains only additional restoration/replay/ordinary work not already counted; B lookup and included identity/presence test are neither separate R nor T
